description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P306 decent M-05 + H-03 misses: cross-chain value flows refund/return funds to the WRONG recipient. Two sub-shapes: (i) a cross-chain send in an intermediary (router/adapter/executor) sets the LayerZero refundAddress to msg.sender — but msg.sender is the intermediary, so refunded gas is stranded (M-05); (ii) an executor-style function that takes a source-chain `from`/`sender` param, makes an external target.call, and on failure refunds to that `from` — a foreign-chain address that may be unusable/attacker-influenced on this chain (H-03). Suppress: refund to address(this)/a freshly-validated user; views; non-intermediary direct user entrypoints for (i).

fp_controls.subshape_i: cross-chain send + refund/refundAddress set to msg.sender + the contract is an intermediary (name router/adapter/executor/bridge OR has an onlyX modifier) -> refund stranded at the intermediary.
fp_controls.subshape_ii: a source-chain `from`/`sender` param + an external target.call + a failure branch that refunds to that param -> refund to a foreign-chain address.
